Name: Provence Rustique
Category Description:
Provence Rustique is an olfactory journey to the sun-drenched countryside of southern France, where lavender fields stretch beyond the horizon and warm stone houses glow in golden evening light. This collection captures the essence of rustic elegance — natural, effortless, and deeply comforting.

Fresh herbal notes of lavender, sage, and wild thyme blend seamlessly with soft honeyed accords, ripe fig, and gentle cedarwood. The result is a balanced composition that feels both airy and grounded, bright yet soothing.

Each candle in the Provence Rustique collection is designed to bring a sense of calm, warmth, and authenticity into your space — like a quiet terrace overlooking olive groves, where time slows and the air carries the scent of sun and earth.

Name: Château & Terre
Category Description:
Château & Terre is a tribute to the timeless charm of the French countryside — where aged stone walls, oak barrels, and flickering candlelight create an atmosphere of quiet refinement. This collection captures the depth and warmth of rustic estates, blending earthy richness with understated elegance.

Notes of oakwood, dark plum, terracotta spice, and golden amber unfold in layered harmony, evoking the scent of wine cellars, sun-warmed clay, and polished wood. Each fragrance feels grounded, intimate, and quietly luxurious.

Château & Terre brings the soul of a countryside château into your space — warm, enveloping, and crafted for those who appreciate depth, texture, and timeless character.

Name: Mediterranean Hearth
Category Description:
Mediterranean Hearth captures the warmth of coastal evenings where sun-soaked stone, olive groves, and sea-kissed air come together in perfect harmony. Inspired by rustic villas and open courtyards, this collection radiates comfort, light, and effortless southern charm.

Bright citrus notes of lemon and bergamot blend with olive leaf, fig, and a touch of rosemary, grounded by soft woods and warm amber. The composition feels fresh yet inviting, like a gentle breeze drifting through terracotta walls at sunset.

Mediterranean Hearth brings the glow of the Mediterranean into your home — luminous, relaxed, and beautifully timeless.

Name: Andalusian Nights
Category Description:
Andalusian Nights is inspired by the sultry evenings of southern Spain, where lanterns glow against whitewashed walls and warm air carries the scent of spice and orange blossom. This collection captures the mystery and passion of twilight courtyards and moonlit terraces.

Rich notes of saffron, dark orange blossom, and spiced almond unfold over a base of sandalwood, amber, and soft smoke. The fragrance is deep and enveloping, balancing sweetness with warmth and subtle intensity.

Andalusian Nights fills your space with a sensual, intimate glow — bold yet elegant, like a quiet night beneath the Andalusian sky.

Name: Desert Resin
Category Description:
Desert Resin is a tribute to the silent beauty of endless dunes and sun-scorched horizons, where warm wind carries the scent of rare woods and precious resins. This collection embodies depth, stillness, and the quiet power of the desert at dusk.

Smoky oud and rich amber blend with myrrh, dry cedarwood, and a subtle touch of spice, creating a fragrance that is warm, resinous, and gently intoxicating. The composition unfolds slowly, revealing layers of earth, heat, and golden light.

Desert Resin fills your space with a grounded, meditative atmosphere — mysterious, refined, and deeply captivating.

Name: Tuscan Glow
Category Description:
Tuscan Glow is inspired by the golden light that washes over rolling hills and stone villas at sunset. This collection captures the warmth of Tuscany — sunlit terraces, ripening citrus groves, and the soft hum of late summer evenings.

Bright notes of lemon zest and bergamot open into green olive leaf and sweet fig, resting on a gentle base of cypress wood and warm amber. The fragrance feels radiant yet grounded, fresh yet softly enveloping.

Tuscan Glow brings a luminous, relaxed elegance into your space — like a quiet evening in the Italian countryside, where everything is bathed in honeyed light. 🕯🍋
